map.穴位配伍（开四关）组合推荐 使用指南: Acupoint Combination (Opening the Four Gates) Recommendation User Guide
map.基于合谷、太冲等「开四关」经典配伍思路，按调理目标推荐穴位组合与定位，供针灸爱好: Following the classic "opening the four gates" combination idea with Hegu and Taichong, it recommends point combinations and locations for the chosen goal, for reference by acupuncture enthusiasts and therapists (for reference only, not medical advice).
map.调理肝郁取合谷、太冲。: For liver qi stagnation, use Hegu and Taichong.
map.安神定志加神门、三阴交。: To calm the mind and settle the spirit, add Shenmen and Sanyinjiao.
map.头面诸疾取合谷配风池。: For head and facial conditions, combine Hegu with Fengchi.
map.：目标「疏肝理气」，推荐双侧合谷+双侧太冲（开四关），并配太冲同经行间以清肝；定: For the goal "soothe the liver and regulate qi" it recommends bilateral Hegu plus bilateral Taichong (opening the four gates), adding Xingjian on the same meridian as Taichong to clear the liver. Hegu lies between the 1st and 2nd metacarpal bones on the back of the hand and Taichong between the 1st and 2nd metatarsals on the dorsum of the foot, for reference when locating the points.

map.开四关适合所有人吗？: Is opening the four gates suitable for everyone?
map.多用于气机郁滞、痛证、神志病；孕妇忌合谷、三阴交，出血倾向者慎用；本工具结果仅供: Used mainly for qi stagnation, pain conditions and mental disorders; pregnant women should avoid Hegu and Sanyinjiao, and those with a bleeding tendency should use it with caution. The results here are for reference only and do not replace a physician's diagnosis and prescription; follow medical advice when performing.
map.配穴越多越好吗？: Is the more accompanying points the better?
map.不是，主配分明、少而精，避免多穴杂投；针刺请由医师辨证取穴。: No, the main points should be clear, few and precise, avoiding a scatter of many points; acupuncture point selection has to be made by a physician on pattern differentiation.
